turns.user: Can I place a direct order for ₹80,000 of cartons without raising a purchase request first?
turns.agent:
No. The purchase policy only allows a direct order without a request if the total value is at or below the limit. You must raise a purchase request first because your amount is higher.

Source: Purchase Policy §3.3; Purchase Policy §3.1

turns.user: Can I still charge new orders to cost centre PRD-05?
turns.agent:
Yes, if it is still open. The policy requires every order to be charged to an open cost centre, so you must check its status in Bahi or ask Finance first.

Source: Purchase Policy §4.2; Purchase Policy §4.1

cases.name: Policy · does PR approval cover the PO

turns.user: If Rohit approves my purchase request, does that also cover the purchase order raised against it?
turns.agent:
Yes, it does. The policy allows this provided that Rohit's approval limit covers the gross value of the purchase order.

Source: Purchase Policy §5.4; Purchase Policy §3.4

cases.name: Policy · limit on basic or gross

turns.user: Is my ₹2,50,000 approval limit on the basic value or including GST?
turns.agent:
Yes, it includes GST. The purchase policy states that approval limits apply to the gross value including GST and not the basic value.

Source: Purchase Policy §5.1; Purchase Policy §3.3
